name: RPP sell-triggered burn from the liquidity pair
summary: RPP's _transfer burns 2.06% of every sell amount out of the RPP/USDT pair's balance and syncs it before the sold tokens arrive, so each sell lifts the RPP price for the seller. With a 1.2M USDT flash loan the attacker bought RPP in 1,450 capped swaps, then sold it back in 215 swaps whose pair burns removed 3.73M RPP, and kept the pair's surplus USDT.
notes: The pair's 14,685 USDT was its whole quote liquidity, added 3,100 blocks earlier (ref); the RPP that left the pair was bought with flash-loaned USDT, burnt or paid to the fee receiver, so only the USDT is counted. No other transaction on the token before or after drew USDT from the pair.
